# How many tests pass on each platform: the sum of `test result: ok. N passed` over a full
# `cargo test --no-fail-fast` run, as CI measures it. CI fails on any difference, either way
# (scripts/ci_guards.py test-count). A PR that adds tests raises the number in the same diff; a PR
# that removes tests lowers it and names the removed tests in its body (build rule 14).
linux 1744
windows 1738
